engine.name: motion-pillow-ffmpeg
engine.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: Transitions between scenes are crossfades computed in the frame renderer.
Depth is suggested by layered parallax; there are no true 3D depth maps.
Icons are drawn as vector primitives with Pillow, not imported SVG glyphs (no SVG rasteriser is installed on this machine).
No licensed music is bundled; audio defaults to a synthesized pad (labelled).
The DEMO / CONCEPT PREVIEW watermark is stamped on every preview frame.

validation.note: Technical validation only — ffprobe cannot judge how the film looks or sounds. A human must review the picture and audio.

mixing: music synthesized from sine waves — NOT licensed music
